literal: Fearlessness other than, aid is not needed, without omission having considered, with the place if done.
translation: If one considers every detail thoroughly and acts in the right place, no ally is needed other than one's own fearlessness.
modern: எதையும் விட்டுவிடாமல் முழுமையாக ஆராய்ந்து, தகுந்த இடத்தில் ஒரு செயலைச் செய்தால், ஒருவருக்குத் தன் அஞ்சாமையைத் தவிர வேறு எந்தத் துணையும் தேவையில்லை.
explanation: This couplet highlights the immense strategic value of choosing the right location for an undertaking. The word 'எஞ்சாமை' means without omission, stressing the need for flawless and complete planning. When thorough preparation is combined with the perfect place to act, the resulting advantage is so great that a person's own courage becomes the only ally they require.
